corrections.why: The Former Fire Lookout Sites entry reads Standing ruin and says the tower was derelict by 2005 with cabin remains on top. The record's gone is not supported by that entry.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record has gone (FFLA) and standing (OSM). The FFLOS entry says standing ruin. The OSM way 1301160223 carries only building and fire_lookout tags and gives no condition, so it does not show the tower standing. Recorded as ruins.

notes_for_editor: Built date, staffing names (1919, 1932, 1943) and the derelict-by-2005 description are well sourced; there is no source for anything after 2005 beyond the register's Standing ruin label, and the story says so. Corrected status gone to ruins against the FFLOS entry. The brief's FFLA gone was not checked against the FFLA list entry. The OSM way 1301160223 (fire_lookout tag) is not cited: it shows a mapped feature only. Do not confuse this Lake County site with the Sierra NF Goat Mountain (Madera County; FFLOS US 2051; weebly goat-mountain.html), whose 1949 items are not used here. No photos recorded: the register's 1920 and 2005 photo credits and the weebly page's 1963 credit have no image URLs in the cached text. One web search used; it returned no new Lake County facts.
